title: Epic's Disney game is reportedly going AI-first 🤖
subject: epicgames
description:
Would you play a game built AI-first? 👇

Bloomberg reports that Epic Games told developers on its unannounced Disney shooter, featuring Marvel and Star Wars characters, to switch to 'AI-first' development, with art made through full AI workflows and no more handwritten code. On October 12, Tim Sweeney confirmed 'a huge pivot' toward 'maximum AI acceleration' at Epic.

Sources: Bloomberg (Oct 12, 2026) via VGC and Push Square, Tim Sweeney on X (Oct 12, 2026)

scenes.text: Epic is reportedly going AI-first on its Disney shooter.
scenes.search: video game developer office computer screens

scenes.text: According to Bloomberg, the unannounced game features Marvel and Star Wars characters.
A director reportedly told staff that all art will be made with full AI workflows, and there will be no more handwritten code.
Developers would manage and guide AI tools instead.
On October 12, CEO Tim Sweeney confirmed a huge pivot toward maximum AI acceleration at Epic.
He says the goal isn't fewer people, but building more and better stuff.
